title: Flow-GRPO cost and noise schedule
fallback: Flow-GRPO planner (illustrative): group size 16, 32 prompts per step, 10 training SDE steps, noise level a 0.7, KL beta 0.04 — 512 rollouts and 5120 SDE evaluations per step. The page plots sigma_t = a*sqrt(t/(1-t)) and can ask the agent to recompute an illustrative cost from demo constants (not measurements).

actions.label: Recompute with agent
actions.prompt: Recompute this page's illustrative Flow-GRPO cost from the values above and send it with return_ui_result as data of exactly this shape: {"rollouts_per_step": number, "sde_evals_per_step": number, "gpu_hours": number, "focus": string, "phases": [{"label": "sampling", "value": number}, {"label": "reward", "value": number}, {"label": "update", "value": number}]}. rollouts_per_step = prompts × group_size; sde_evals_per_step = rollouts_per_step × sde_steps; phase values are seconds per training step from the page's demo constants: sampling = sde_evals_per_step × 0.05, reward = rollouts_per_step × 0.02, update = sde_evals_per_step × 0.03, each rounded to one decimal; gpu_hours = (sampling + reward + update) × 100 / 3600 for 100 training steps, rounded to two decimals; focus = the focus in the input. The constants are the page's assumptions, not hardware measurements or published figures; say so in the answer, and say which focus was asked for. The page shows nothing from data without these fields.

actions.label: Ask, then recompute
actions.prompt: Before recomputing, ask the person with request_input for the prompts per step to use (an integer from 1 to 512) and the focus (cost or stability); then recompute as the "Recompute with agent" action does, with the prompts per step and the focus they gave in place of the page's, and send it with return_ui_result as data of the same shape. If they decline, send nothing and say so.
